title: Before you use Project Daystrom
independence: Project Daystrom is an unofficial community project. It is neither developed nor supported by Scopely.
operationAndRisk: Daystrom modifies the game and loads its own code into the running game process. Game updates can therefore make Daystrom temporarily incompatible. Although Daystrom is designed to fail as safely as possible, we cannot guarantee error-free operation or protection against the loss of local data. You use it at your own risk.
accountProtection: Before using Daystrom, link your game account to a Scopely ID. This helps you recover access independently of locally stored profiles and sign-in data.
windowsRemoval: If you want to remove Daystrom, close the game first. Then use “Remove mod” in Daystrom before uninstalling Project Daystrom in Windows Settings.
